The harsh sunlight weather condition.
It boosts the power of Fire-type moves and
lowers the power of Water-type moves.

The rain weather condition.
It boosts the power of Water-type moves and
lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

The sandstorm weather condition.
At the end of each turn, it damages all Pokémon
that are not Rock, Ground, or Steel types.
It boosts the Sp. Def of Rock-type Pokémon.

The snow weather condition.
It makes Blizzard more likely to hit and
boosts the Defense of Ice-type Pokémon.

For five turns, Pokémon on the ground won’t
fall asleep.
The power of Electric-type moves is boosted.

For five turns, Pokémon on the ground will have
a little HP restored at the end of each turn.
The power of Grass-type moves is boosted.

For five turns, Pokémon on the ground won’t get
any status conditions.
Damage from Dragon-type moves is halved.
Slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
Pokémon can’t use their held items for five turns.

Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def are swapped for
five turns.
The Pokémon is more likely to land critical hits.

The Pokémon may hurt itself in its confusion.
The effect lasts for one to four turns.

The Pokémon is less likely to unleash an attack
on Pokémon of the opposite gender.

The Pokémon will lose HP each turn as long as
it is sleeping.

The Pokémon will fall asleep at the end of the
turn if it remains on the battlefield.

Due to Encore, the Pokémon can use only
<U+0010><U+0002>ć<U+0000> for three turns.

The Pokémon can’t use the same move twice
in a row.

The Speed stats of a Pokémon and its allies are
doubled for four turns.

The opponent’s moves won’t result in a
critical hit.

If the Pokémon faints as a result of a move,
the PP of that move will be reduced to 0.

For five turns, the Pokémon is unable to recover
HP through its moves, Ability, or held item.

The Pokémon will be hit by certain moves
that usually wouldn’t affect it.
If the Pokémon’s evasiveness has been boosted,
the benefits will be ignored when it is attacked.

<U+0010><U+0002>ć<U+0000> has been disabled and

The Pokémon can’t flee or be switched out.

item and no items can be used on it.

The power of the next Electric-type move used
by the Pokémon will be doubled.

Moves are more likely to hit for five turns.
Ground-type moves will hit Flying-type
Pokémon and Pokémon with the Levitate Ability.
Moves that require action midair can’t be used.

The Pokémon’s stats won’t be lowered for
five turns.

The Pokémon is protected from status conditions
for five turns.
Pokémon that switch into battle will take damage.

The Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats
